message: Instant server-side revoke/delete enforcement. The License Admin now sends a cryptographically signed access command directly to the Supabase live licensing database before publishing the durable GitHub backup. The game checks the live authority every 250 ms. A live License-ID or Hardware-ID block returns HTTP 403 and immediately terminates the protected core/browser session; GitHub propagation is no longer in the real-time kill path. Startup preflight and offline-play denial remain enabled.
